_note: Tickets 08 and 17: scripted Counter-offer breaches. Each flag's Source sentence is exact, so every flag shows. Late fee: no breach; "fine" next to an amount and "May" the month are both exempt, so nothing is marked. Termination: "may" is in the proposed wording and must be marked. Fee: 14 is not in the document and must be marked as a number, not withheld. Liability: adds insurance, a term the document does not contain; code cannot catch it, so it shows unmarked (a person reads for it, PRD criterion 17). Visits: no counterOffer at all; the flag still shows, with the no-Counter-offer line.
